id: \rCaptain Aidan does such a good job raising his Pokémon firefighters.
en: \rCaptain Aidan does such a good job raising his Pokémon firefighters.
it: \rIl Capitano Aidan è bravissimo a crescere i suoi Pokémon pompieri.

id: \rI want to grow up and help stop fires!
en: \rI want to grow up and help stop fires!
it: \rDa grande voglio aiutare a spegnere gli incendi!

id: \bCaptain Aidan: One of my Wartortle is missing. It has a scarf on it; you can't miss it.
en: \bCaptain Aidan: One of my Wartortle is missing. It has a scarf on it; you can't miss it.
it: \bCapitano Aidan: Manca uno dei miei Wartortle. Ha una sciarpa addosso: non puoi non notarlo.

id: \bCaptain Aidan: Thank you for helping out my Wartortle. Let me reward you.
en: \bCaptain Aidan: Thank you for helping out my Wartortle. Let me reward you.
it: \bCapitano Aidan: Grazie per aver aiutato il mio Wartortle. Lascia che ti ricompensi.

id: \bCaptain Aidan: I raised all my Pokémon with lots of care. They can stop any fire that comes their way.
en: \bCaptain Aidan: I raised all my Pokémon with lots of care. They can stop any fire that comes their way.
it: \bCapitano Aidan: Ho cresciuto tutti i miei Pokémon con grande cura. Possono spegnere qualsiasi incendio si trovino davanti.

id: \bCaptain Aidan: You have a wonderful member of the Squirtle family. How would you like me to train one of your Pokémon?
en: \bCaptain Aidan: You have a wonderful member of the Squirtle family. How would you like me to train one of your Pokémon?
it: \bCapitano Aidan: Hai un magnifico membro della famiglia di Squirtle. Ti piacerebbe che allenassi uno dei tuoi Pokémon?

id: \bOh? But you only have one with you.
en: \bOh?  But you only have one with you.
it: \bOh? Ma ne hai solo uno con te.

id: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to raise?
en: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to raise?
it: \bQuale Pokémon vuoi che alleni?

id: \bFine.
en: \bFine.
it: \bVa bene.

id: \bf you leave me that Pokémon, what are you gonna battle with?
en: \bf you leave me that Pokémon, what are you gonna battle with?

id: \bCome back with some common sense.
en: \bCome back with some common sense.
it: \bTorna quando avrai un po' di buon senso.

id: \bI'll raise your \v[3] for a while.
en: \bI'll raise your \v[3] for a while.

en: \bI can raise two of your Pokémon. Would you like me to raise another?

id: \bOh? But you only have one Pokémon with you.
en: \bOh? But you only have one Pokémon with you.

en: \bYou can't go off without a Pokémon. Come back another time.

id: \bI can always train one for you.
en: \bI can always train one for you.

en: \bFine, I'll raise your \v[3] for a while.

id: \bCome back for it later.

en: \bHey \PN. How's it going? Your Pokémon got stronger.
